jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Company Description

HumanizedText is an AI-powered writing platform that helps make AI-generated content more natural and readable. We build AI writing, humanization, grammar, tone, and developer tools for creators, professionals, students, and developers.

Role Description

We’re looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our remote engineering team. You’ll work on real product features, backend services, APIs, debugging, and AI-powered tools while learning from experienced engineers.

Qualifications

Strong foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and basic software engineering concepts.
Practical experience or coursework in Software Development and Programming, with proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar).
Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and ability to apply them to design and implement modular, reusable code.
Exposure to Back-End Web Development, such as working with APIs, databases, or server-side frameworks, is preferred.
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to work effectively in a remote setting, manage time independently, and communicate clearly in written and spoken English.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and basic software development tools; interest in learning modern development workflows and best practices.
Curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn from feedback and collaborate with a diverse engineering team.

jobs.title: Web Development Intern
jobs.description:
Web Development Intern
Company:
Zenithbyte
Location:
Remote
Duration:
3 Months
Application Deadline:
25th August 2026

For College Students Only!

About Zenithbyte
Zenithbyte provides students and graduates with practical exposure to modern web development through real-world projects and industry mentorship. The program is designed to help aspiring developers build technical expertise, strengthen problem-solving skills, and gain experience with industry-standard tools and technologies.

Roles & Responsibilities

Develop and maintain responsive, user-friendly websites and web applications.
Build interactive front-end interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Assist in developing back-end functionalities and APIs.
Debug, test, and optimize applications for performance and scalability.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive designs.
Work with version control systems such as Git and GitHub.
Participate in code reviews and follow industry best practices.
Collaborate with the development team on live client and internal projects.

Requirements

Enrolled in or recently graduated from Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Familiarity with responsive web design principles.
Basic knowledge of React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar front-end frameworks (preferred).
Basic understanding of Node.js, Express.js, PHP, or Python back-end development (preferred).
Familiarity with Git/GitHub and basic database concepts (MySQL or MongoDB) is an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

What You Will Gain

Hands-on experience working on live web development projects.
Swags and goodies.
Certificate of Internship upon successful completion.
Letter of Recommendation based on performance.
Opportunity to build a strong portfolio with real-world web applications.
Learn modern development tools, frameworks, and industry best practices.
Mentorship from experienced developers.
Potential full-time role based on performance.
Performance-Based Stipend up to ₹7,500/month.

How to Apply

Submit your application with the subject line:
"Web Development Intern Application – Zenithbyte"

Equal Opportunity Statement
Zenithbyte
is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We are committed to fostering diversity, inclusion, innovation, and professional growth for every intern.
